spec.name: Blend v10
spec.notes: Blend of trend, earnings surprise and a volatility penalty.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.7, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 10%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation, raising concerns about overfitting. The inclusion of transaction costs is positive, but the relatively low maximum drawdown compared to the annual return warrants further scrutiny. The research log indicates this is not the best performing variant, and only a small number of trials were run. Paper trading is recommended to validate performance on unseen data.
